passives: Kami Threshold Law: Izanami Shrine Tide gains Shrine Resonance when its breaker choices express Sacred Kingdoms source-culture law through torii-marked sacred threshold; Earth myth is only the later echo.
lore: Izanami Shrine Tide is a colossal Kami breaker from The Sacred Kingdoms. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Deity is the older source: Kami breaker office: judgement rupture, armor sundering, trial by force; Tengu: mountain wind, discipline, masks, feathers.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source deity, not a costume: Izanami Shrine Tide shows torii silhouettes, shrine lacquer red, white paper shide, braided shimenawa cords, mirror discs, foxfire blue, ink-wash smoke, cedar bark, moonlit silk, oni iron, tengu feather wind, dragon-rain scales, mask geometry, seasonal petals and ash.. Role silhouette must read as Fracture. Materials include lacquered shrine red, aged cedar, white paper shide, braided straw rope, moonlit silk, black ink smoke, foxfire blue. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid anime mecha samurai, generic ninja, literal shrine body, plastic kimono costume, random kanji text, neon cyberpunk.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Izanami Shrine Tide — Kagura Spirit Cut Rend
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Kami source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Shrine Resonance gain when used from torii-marked sacred threshold or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as torii silhouettes, shimenawa cords, white shide seals, mirror silver, foxfire blue, cedar lacquer, tengu wind, oni iron, dragon rain.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Shide Seal Technique — Rupture
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Builds Shrine Resonance only when the Avatar uses torii-marked sacred threshold intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Izanami Shrine Tide: Torii Boundary Rewrite Sundering Trial
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Shrine Resonance to impose a two-round rule from Sacred Kingdoms: breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Amaterasu Moon-Gate Radiance
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Shrine Resonance, transform nearby terrain into torii-marked sacred threshold, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Izanami Shrine Tide Sunderer Mirror-Talisman Spirit Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through torii-marked sacred threshold. Visual: torii silhouettes, shimenawa cords, white shide seals, mirror silver, foxfire blue, cedar lacquer, tengu wind, oni iron, dragon rain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Izanami Shrine Tide Lacquered Shimenawa Spirit-Guard
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Sacred Kingdoms source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Izanami Shrine Tide Kitsune Foxfire Magatama Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Shrine Resonance and unlocks a mastery branch for Torii Moonstep, Kitsune Misdirection Counter, and Purify the Trespass. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.
